decision.reasoning: Mbeumo (form 1.7, £7.8m) is the weakest high-cost player; swapping him for Ødegaard (form 5.7, ARS with a solid run) upgrades the midfield for £6.7m, leaving £3.2m in the bank. Tzolakis starts over Donnarumma (form 1.3) on better form. Evanilson captains on 8.0 form, Haaland vice.
